\[
5 \times 733 = 3665 \text{ feet}
\]

After the new 885-foot building is constructed, it becomes one of the five tallest, and the shortest of the original five, 625 feet, is no longer among the five tallest.

New total height of the five tallest buildings:

\[
3665 - 625 + 885 = 3925 \text{ feet}
\]

New mean height:

\[
\frac{3925}{5} = 785 \text{ feet}
\]

Increase in mean height:

\[
785 - 733 = 52 \text{ feet}
\]

The answer is 52 feet.
